desc: Rebuild the right-port USB2-native kernel with v2 of the PHY slice (patch b7f02c3c, dwc3 -EINVAL fix, independently reviewed in evidence/2026-08-04-t6040-usb2-slice-v2-independent-review.md) so ticket 108 can re-run. Profile is the PINNED flag set from evidence/2026-07-29-t6040-integrated-wifi-bt-usb2-dualmode-candidate.md (the doc that built the exact booted image 3caa0f78): DOCKCHANNEL=1 DOCKCHANNEL_NBCON=1 HID_TYPE_FIX=1 T6040_INTEGRATED=1 T6040_PPP=1 MACSMC=1 WIFI=1 PCIE=1 USB_HOST=1 USB_HOST_PORT=right T6040_USB2_NATIVE=1. (A first attempt reconstructed the flags from the image name and missed T6040_INTEGRATED=1; kbuild's fail-closed gate rejected it before configuring -- name reconstruction is not a substitute for the pinned build doc.) ACCEPTANCE: (1) built config byte-identical to the saved config-macsmc-hid-type-fix-nbcon-ppp-usb2-native-right (v2 changes no Kconfig; any config drift means wrong flags -- fix flags, not the baseline); (2) two clean builds from independent BUILD_DIRs byte-identical; (3) artifacts copied to *-v2phy names immediately (the kbuild output names collide with the sibling's future builds in /out) and hashes pinned here; (4) exact binary review by a non-builder (fable built, so claude or CJ reviews) before any rig re-run of 108. This unblocks 108 whose 2026-08-04 run failed at dwc3 core init; per the R3 boundary design there is a real chance the right port already sources VBUS, so this rebuild alone may enumerate the S128 stick. NUMBERING NOTE: seq 303 in fable's declared 300+ block per coordination instruction 2026-08-04. RESULT 2026-08-18 (fable): built with the Jul-29 kbuild script @11f2547 against tree 4f2429104009 -- today's script produces a superset config (BT, NVMe=y: caught by the config gate; NVMe would also hazard the 108 observation via ticket 227). Config byte-identical to the pinned Jul-29 baseline 221666c6. Two FRESH-tree builds (fb, fc) byte-identical: Image 80248306, System.map 793adc56, named *-v2phy.buildB/.buildC. An incremental build in a reused dir (buildA 88e064d5, kept as tainted record) differed by ONE stale-object byte in brcmf_inform_bss -- the two-build protocol caught it; rule added to BUILD_RECIPE (never reuse a BUILD_DIR across script versions). Content delta vs the Jul-29 image: the v2 phy hunk, traps.c +5 (205 track), the version-string sha. DTB regenerated 6df8af39 (full hash in evidence; source delta since Jul 29 has zero USB tokens and every new node is driverless under this config). Preflight OK with initramfs-sdroot-hardened. ALSO FOUND: the canonical Jul-29 $OUT artifacts were overwritten 2026-08-04 13:37 by the TYPEC_PD compile-proof build; pins survive byte-exact in .xz/.hid-build1, Aug-4 binaries preserved as .aug4-clobber. REMAINING: exact binary review by a non-builder (fable built => claude or CJ), then the 108 re-run with IMAGE=Image-usb2-native-right-v2phy.buildB.
